name: Model Serving Platforms & GPU Inference
description: Cloud-native model serving on Kubernetes: KServe, Seldon Core, Ray Serve, vLLM / TGI high-throughput LLM engines, dynamic GPU autoscaling, ingress routing, and service mesh.

subskills.name: KServe & InferenceService Custom Resource (CRD)
subskills.description: Deploying models using KServe InferenceService CRDs, predictor, transformer, explainer components, serverless scale-to-zero with Knative, and storageInitializer.

subskills.name: Seldon Core & Complex Inference Graphs
subskills.description: SeldonDeployment CRD, building multi-model inference pipelines (Combiners, Routers, Ensembles), shadow deployments, and AB testing.

subskills.name: Ray Serve Distributed Serving & Deployments
subskills.description: Ray Serve @serve.deployment, managing replica actors, dynamic batching, actor concurrency, and scaling across heterogeneous Ray clusters.

subskills.name: High-Throughput Serving Engines (vLLM & TGI)
subskills.description: Operating vLLM (PagedAttention) and Text Generation Inference (TGI), continuous batching, tensor parallelism, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

subskills.name: GPU Autoscaling with KEDA & Prometheus Metrics
subskills.description: Configuring Kubernetes Event-driven Autoscaling (KEDA) on GPU metrics (DCGM GPU duty cycle, queue latency, request backlog) rather than basic CPU/memory.

subskills.name: Dynamic Batching & Concurrent Model Execution
subskills.description: Triton dynamic batch scheduler, max_queue_delay_microseconds, multi-model GPU memory sharing, and maximizing inference throughput.

subskills.name: Istio Service Mesh & Canary Traffic Splitting
subskills.description: Using Istio VirtualService and DestinationRule to split live prediction traffic (90% v1 / 10% v2) and mirror traffic for shadow evaluation.

subskills.name: Inference Caching (Redis & Semantic Cache)
subskills.description: Caching frequent prediction requests in Redis, vector semantic caching (GPTCache), and sub-millisecond response for repeat queries.

subskills.name: GPU Cold Start Latency Reduction & Pre-Warming
subskills.description: Techniques to eliminate GPU cold start: pre-pulled daemonset container images, warm pools, memory-mapped weights, and rapid model hydration.

cv.signal: Deployed and scaled KServe and vLLM inference platforms on Kubernetes with KEDA GPU autoscaling and Istio traffic splitting

linkedin.signal: KServe, Ray Serve, vLLM, and Model Serving endorsements

assessment.signal: Passes Model Serving Platforms & GPU Inference Technical Assessment

junior.description: Deploys standard KServe InferenceServices, configures dynamic batching, and implements Redis prediction caching.

mid.description: Builds complex Seldon inference graphs, operates Ray Serve and vLLM clusters, and routes traffic via Istio Canary rules.

senior.description: Architects event-driven KEDA GPU autoscaling on DCGM metrics and eliminates cold start bottlenecks across multi-region serverless GPU fleets.
